title: Motorcyclist dies in Zamboanga del Sur highway crash

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A 56-year-old motorcycle rider from Marikina City died on Friday evening, October 16, after his maxi-scooter rammed a parked truck along the national highway in Mahayag, Zamboanga del Sur. In a report released Saturday, Police Capt. Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson for the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office (ZSPPO), said the incident occurred at around 7:50 p.m. in Purok 1, Barangay Kaangayan. Initial investigations showed that the victim was traveling from Zamboanga City to Pagadian City with a group of big-bike riders from Metro Manila via the Sindangan -Dumingag Road.
